Context: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS  
1. Define an interest-free advance and enumerate its maximum limit.  
An advance for LTC can be drawn for up to 90% of the. estimated cost of travel including both outward and return [ourrreys,  
品  
2. What is the maximum cost of the house for which you, can avail a House Building Advance?  
The maximum cost of the house to be built/ purchased (excluding the cost of the plot) should not exceed ~ 1 crore.
